notes: Client: Acuma Product Labs — building agentic workflow for customer support automation. Evaluating Hosted API as first step, with intent to move to Dedicated if latency/cost targets met. Primary workload: streaming chat agents that call internal search and action APIs (multi-step: search -> plan -> action). Strict latency SLO: 95th <= 600ms for in-chat tool calls; overall response aim <= 1s for top-paths. Observed issues during POC: tool-call reliability/timeouts when chaining search+action (timeouts at 800-1200ms), partial responses requiring retries. Interested in streaming to improve UX; also need function/tool calling with guaranteed idempotency and retries. Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, retention controls. Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget; looking at Hosted costs first, but dedicated pricing needed for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost. Quote request: expected ARR 50-150k with potential to scale. Next: run 48-hour synthetic load to reproduce tool-call timeouts, then schedule dedicated pricing + architecture call. Notes from demo: "streaming is night-and-day for UX"; Diego to prototype retry/backoff for tool-calls. Blocker: unclear SLA on tool-call fallbacks and cross-region routing during outages.
requirements_summary: Agentic chat workflow (search + action) requiring streaming, function/tool calling, and strict latency SLOs. Need reliable multi-step tool execution with retries/rollback and observability into tool-call failures. POC to validate Held orders: 95th latency <=600ms, sustained throughput 50 reqs/s, deterministic fallback to lighter model on tool failure.
demo_feedback: Hosted API streaming + function calling performed well for single-step flows. Multi-step tool chains exposed timeout/reliability gaps. Client liked streaming UX and rollbacks for failed calls. Wants explicit docs on recommended retry/backoff patterns and config for tool-call timeouts.
